sections.text: General Electric
مقدمة

This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The Cathodic Protection function is to protect the metallic parts from 
corrosion, this protection can be found in the following places: 
 -
Beside the Nile water pumps 
-
Beside the compensation tanks
 -
The 400 Volt room for gas units 
-
The fire fighting building

The first draft initiated by eng. Abd El-Gayd Abd 
El-Wahab, reviewed eng. Mahmoud Abd el Hamid El kholy tested by eng. Saad 
El Saed Rageh, accepted by 
eng. Yousry Ahmed Abd El Maksoud general director, revised by by EDEPC inspection and quality control 
eng. Adel Abd El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. Awad Fathy head sector of Talkha PS.

This document
accepted by eng. Samir Abd El-Gilil, EDEPC MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant 
Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman admin and financial inspection quality controls general 
director, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection and quality controls head sector.

Read the AC I/P current on the AC ammeter

the transformer is OK
